_readme: Hand resolutions for rrFetch call sites whose area argument is a variable.
A dynamic area cannot be classified by reading the call, so each one was
read once, by a person, and recorded here with the reason. v8-callsites.py
fails if a dynamic site has no entry (A2a) AND if an entry no longer matches
a live call site (A2b) -- a stale exemption is how a gate goes quiet without
Key is "<file>::<identifier>", not file:line. A line number shifts on every
edit above it and the entry silently stops matching; an identifier survives
edits and fails loudly if renamed.
`area` is the path WITHOUT any query string -- the query is per-call and
does not change routing or authorization.
Resolved 2026-09-07, each by reading the assignment immediately above its

Removed 2026-09-15 (VLC-63 increment 2): home.html::_ctxUrl, ::_acUrl and ::_wlUrl. All three built 'api/v1/ai/explain' + '?ctx=' by hand at their call sites. aiExplain() now assembles the URL from a ctx VALUE, so those three identifiers no longer exist and A2b reported the exemptions as covering nothing -- which is exactly what it is for. One entry, home.html::_aiExUrl, replaces them.

accounting-model-review.html::area.why: loadVerdict builds the model-approval area + optional '?company='. Counts only; the retired sign-off fields are deliberately not read (accounting-model-review.html:1115).

home.html::_aiExUrl.why: aiExplain() -- the ONE producer for an AI explain call (VLC-63 increment 2, 2026-09-15). Builds 'api/v1/ai/explain' + the caller's optional '?ctx=' replay-key discriminator. Ten sites POSTed here directly before this; the tier and configured-state checks now live in one place instead of each call site remembering.

inventory-asof.html::_u.why: As-of Ask surface. Tier rides in the prompt's DATA ACCESS marker, never a `level` body field (inventory-asof.html:2943).

inventory-asof.html::_optUrl.why: As-of residual-target optimiser; same explain endpoint, own ctx (inventory-asof.html:3299).

inventory-transactions.html::_ctxUrl.why: Transaction-variance analyze surface; ctx keys on txv + company + period (inventory-transactions.html:8361).
